datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2021 across Nicaragua administrative units. IPC phase classifications (1-5 scale) were spatially mapped to geographic boundaries and compiled into monthly GeoJSON/KML datasets representing food insecurity severity and population affected.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes typically triggered by drought, conflict, or economic shocks.
